title: Badat & Co. v. East India Trading Co.

content.caseIdentity: Badat & Co. v. East India Trading Co., AIR 1964 SC 538
content.holding: Under Order VIII Rules 3, 4, and 5 CPC, vague or evasive denials constitute constructive admissions; denial must be specific and direct.
content.relevance: Doctrine of non-traverse and pleading specificity standards.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (1964) 7 SCR 19; AIR 1964 SC 538; 1963 INSC 124; foreign arbitral awards and CPC jurisdiction.
